children: The current-month Hang Seng China Enterprises Index Futures open interest stood at 214,999 contracts yesterday, down 10,360 from the previous day, according to ETNet.
Including contracts in other months, total open interest was 253,923 contracts, down 10,517.
The note said the figures include current-month open interest in the night session.

title: Hang Seng China Enterprises Index Futures Open Interest Falls 10,360 Contracts
